ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous light-intensity field in the central lobes; low-intensity dark pigmentation along the distal and trailing edges; high-contrast focal dark points scattered across both lobes; one prominent dark vertical band on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude jagged serrations; 5-6 primary peaks on the left lobe trailing edge and 4-5 primary peaks on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on leading edges tapering to acute tips; trailing edges follow an irregular, jagged trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous scattered circular low-intensity clusters appearing as dark spots on the light field, with increased density near the distal fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, high-contrast vertical linear disruption on the left lobe; secondary faint vertical striations observed on the upper portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notches and missing tissue segments along the trailing edge; significant vertical linear scar on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique vertical dark pigment stroke extending from the lower-center of the left lobe.
